final_message:
Configured the 31 authoritative zones on pc1–pc31, with the requested mapping, 30 delegations and glue records. pc32 (`10.15.8.14`) is the recursive resolver; pc33–pc40 use it as clients.

Added the requested MX and mail A records. I assumed the web service for `www.example.com` is on pc6.

Static checks confirmed the zone and delegation counts. BIND validation tools were unavailable locally, and runtime resolution has not been tested. Existing links, addresses and routing were not changed.
